title: 天净沙·秋
author: 白朴
intro: Same tune, same season, same trick of stringing nouns together as “Autumn Thoughts” — but the mood turns from grey to full colour. A great poem to read side by side with Ma Zhiyuan’s.
analysis: 这首小令和马致远的《天净沙·秋思》用的是同一个曲牌，也同样用名词意象叠加的写法，可以放在一起读。前两句写的是一个有点冷清的秋日黄昏：孤零零的村庄、落日、残霞，淡淡的炊烟、老树、寒鸦。接着“一点飞鸿影下”，一只大雁的影子从天上掠过，画面从静变动。最后两句一下子变了：青山、绿水、白草、红叶、黄花——青、绿、白、红、黄，五种颜色排在一起，像一幅明亮的彩色画。前面冷清，后面明丽，秋天不只是悲凉的，也是绚烂的。和《秋思》比较：《秋思》最后落到“断肠人在天涯”，满是思乡的愁；这首没有写人，只写景，情绪从寂寞慢慢转向开阔明朗。同样的写法，可以写出不同的心情。
analysisEn: This song uses the same tune as Ma Zhiyuan’s “Autumn Thoughts” and the same technique of stacking noun images, so the two are perfect to compare. The first two lines paint a rather lonely autumn evening: a solitary village, the setting sun, the last red clouds; a thin wisp of smoke, an old tree, crows in the cold. Then “a single wild goose’s shadow drops past” — something moves across the still picture. The final two lines change everything: blue-green hills, green water, white grass, red leaves, yellow flowers. Five colours in a row, like a bright painting. The lonely first half gives way to a brilliant second half: autumn is not only sad, it is also gorgeous. Compare the two songs. “Autumn Thoughts” ends with a heartbroken traveller far from home — it is all about homesickness. Bai Pu puts no person in the scene at all; the mood simply moves from quiet loneliness to openness and light. The same method can carry very different feelings.
background: Bai Pu (1226–after 1306) lost his mother in the fall of the Jin dynasty as a child and never took office under the Yuan, spending his life as a writer. He is one of the “Four Great Masters” of Yuan drama. 天净沙 is the name of the tune.
pronunciation: 无特殊读音。（“一点”的“一”按本调标 yī，朗读时变调。）
version: 采用通行文本（以古诗文网等通行版本为准），全曲五句二十八字，此处完整收录。“天净沙”是曲牌，“秋”是题目；白朴同曲牌另有春、夏、冬三首。

lines.py: gū cūn luò rì cán xiá
lines.lit: Lonely village, setting sun, remnant clouds;
lines.en: A lonely village, the setting sun, the last red clouds;

lines.py: qīng yān lǎo shù hán yā
lines.lit: light smoke, old tree, cold crows;
lines.en: thin smoke, an old tree, crows in the cold;

lines.py: yī diǎn fēi hóng yǐng xià
lines.lit: one dot — a flying goose’s shadow comes down.
lines.en: the shadow of one wild goose flicks down the sky.

lines.py: bái cǎo hóng yè huáng huā
lines.lit: white grass, red leaves, yellow flowers.
lines.en: white grass, red leaves, yellow flowers.

words.note: 孤：孤单，现代汉语有“孤独”“孤单”。

words.en: the last glow of sunset clouds
words.note: 残：剩下的，如“残余”；霞：彩霞。
这里可能是炊烟，也可能是傍晚的薄雾。
鸿：大雁。今天还有“鸿雁传书”。
指大雁的影子从空中掠过、落下。
“青”在古代可指蓝、绿、黑等颜色，现代汉语仍说“青山绿水”。
诗词里“黄花”常指菊花。今天“黄花菜”是另一种植物。

imagery.name: 夕阳
imagery.zh: 落日残霞写出黄昏的冷清，是前半首寂寞气氛的开始。
imagery.en: The setting sun and fading clouds open the lonely mood of the first half.

imagery.name: 鸦
imagery.zh: 寒鸦和老树、孤村一起，让画面显得萧瑟冷清。
imagery.en: Crows in the cold, with the old tree and lonely village, make the scene bleak.

imagery.name: 雁
imagery.zh: 一只大雁飞过，让静止的画面动了起来，也是由冷清转向明朗的过渡。
imagery.en: A single passing goose sets the still picture moving — and turns the mood from lonely to bright.

imagery.name: 菊
imagery.zh: “黄花”就是秋天的菊花，和青山、绿水、白草、红叶一起组成色彩明丽的秋景。
imagery.en: The “yellow flowers” are autumn chrysanthemums, one of five bright colours that end the song in full glory.
